name: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi
nameAr: يعقوب بن إبراهيم بن كثير بن زيد بن أفلح العبدي مولاهم، أبو يوسف، الدورقي

taqrib.en: Reliable; he was one of the hadith masters.

role: Teacher of all six compilers; author of a Musnad

students.name: Ibn Khuzaymah
students.source: Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah, as cited in Fath al-Bari on hadith 15

verdicts.ar: كان ثقة حافظا متقنا، صنف المسند
verdicts.en: He was reliable, a hadith master, precise; he compiled the Musnad.

dhahabi.source: al-Kashif, as given on the Shamela record

flags.label: The 252 AH cohort
flags.detail: He died in the same year as Muhammad ibn Bashshar (Bundar) and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna (al-Zaman), both likewise born in the late 160s and likewise teachers of all six compilers (Taqrib, entries 5754, 6264, 7812).

flags.label: Nisba not explained here
flags.detail: The class notes derive al-Dawraqi from the caps (dawraqiyyah) worn by his circle rather than from the town of Dawraq, citing al-Maqdisi's al-Jam'. Not verified here; the nisba is entered without an explanation.

bio: A Baghdadi hadith master and brother of Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi, who compiled a Musnad and taught all six compilers. He opens hadith 15 and, in Ibn Khuzaymah's Sahih, carries the same chain with Abd al-Aziz's wording “than his family and his wealth”, which Ibn Hajar uses to show that al-Bukhari joined two routes on the basis of the report, not its exact words.

sources.label: Ibn Hajar, Fath al-Bari on hadith 15 (islamweb)
